name: search-console-quick-wins
description: Every week, finds the pages Google already shows often but few people click, rewrites their search titles and descriptions for you to approve, and a month later reports whether clicks went up.

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: Pages with many impressions, a low click rate and a position of about 4 to 15 in Google

howItWorks.label: Rewrites
howItWorks.text: Their SEO title and meta description around the searches people actually make

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve each rewrite before it is saved

howItWorks.label: Follows up
howItWorks.text: Four weeks later, compares clicks before and after each change

plugins.reason: Reads impressions, clicks, click rate and position per page and search query

data.description: The URL slug or path of the page, to match Search Console's page URLs to records
The page title used by search engines
The meta description used by search engines
Fields that describe the product or page (category, material, use), so rewrites stay accurate

parameters.label: Minimum impressions (28 days)
parameters.description: Pages seen less often than this are left out

parameters.label: Pages to rewrite per week
parameters.description: Small batches make the follow-up easier to read

parameters.label: Title suffix
parameters.description: Added to the end of titles when it fits, e.g. " | Northline Goods"; leave empty for none
